name: Latin Hypercube Pooler
description: Generates a pool of experimental conditions using Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS). Divides the variable ranges into bins, creates hypercube combinations, and samples random values within selected regions for better space coverage than pure random sampling.

pool.name: num_samples
pool.description: The number of samples to generate using Latin Hypercube Sampling.

pool.name: random_state
pool.description: Random seed for reproducibility of the sampling.

inputDataType.name: ivs
inputDataType.description: Variable collection with minimum and maximum values for each independent variable.

outputDataType.name: res
outputDataType.description: DataFrame of experimental conditions sampled using Latin Hypercube design.
